_comment: Every server we run; the launcher shows these. Pictures can be paths in this repo (servers/art/...) or links. background: the main picture; gallery: extra pictures (slideshow). news: newest first, each {title, date, image, tag, url}. status: public | private (needs code) | soon. channels: the builds players can pick, each {id, name, pack, address, code?, note?}; a channel with a codeHash is locked until the player enters its code (Early Access codes for Patreon supporters, Development codes for the team). Only the hash of each code is published. A channel can list several addresses (e.g. Hamachi and a public host); players switch between them. theme: the scene along the bottom of the launcher (wall, peaks). To set a new code, put "code": "..." on the channel instead; the build turns it into a hash. Prefer codeHash so the plain code never sits in the repo.

servers.name: Paradis
servers.tagline: Beyond the walls, the titans wait.
servers.description: An Attack on Titan world to live in. Swing through the cities and giant forests on ODM gear, hunt titans with your squad, follow the story from the 104th onward, and take on extraction runs past the walls.

news.title: Swing sites: ruins, spires, groves and wall breaches in every region
Cutscenes fly between shots and conversations got a new look

servers.name: Kata
servers.description: A martial arts high school. Build your stance and combos, run the rooftops between classes, and settle it on the mat.

news.title: Bodies that bend: elbows, knees and waist, with a pose editor to try them
